title: Fix three off-by-one and logic bugs in Rust statistics library
description: A fresh Rust statistics library has three injected bugs: median uses wrong midpoint, percentile has off-by-one, and std_dev uses n instead of n-1. Fix all bugs to make 8 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:

1. median (even-length): currently computes (data[mid-1] + data[mid-1]) / 2.0
   Fix to: (data[mid-1] + data[mid]) / 2.0

2. percentile (p=100.0 out-of-bounds): idx can equal data.len() when p=100.0
   Fix by clamping: let idx = idx.min(data.len() - 1)

3. std_dev (population vs sample): divides by n instead of n-1
   Fix to divide by (n-1) as f64

All 8 tests must pass after fixing.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: median even-length returns average of two middle elements
percentile p=100.0 returns last element without panic
std_dev divides by n-1 (sample standard deviation)
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
